meta.about: Every weapon of the player's active mods rated by Rimfolk's weapon rating (Source/ColonyCouncil/Weapons/WeaponRateMath.cs); see docs/weapons/README.md.
meta.referenceFighter: Shooting 8 and Melee 8, no traits, a human's natural attacks; normal quality, steel where made of stuff (wood, else granite, otherwise).

tagVocabulary.label: Sniper
tagVocabulary.rule: a long gun: reaches 38 cells or more and is at least as accurate far as near

tagVocabulary.label: Assault
tagVocabulary.rule: an all-round gun or bow

tagVocabulary.label: Close quarters
tagVocabulary.rule: a close weapon: under 20 cells, or under 26 and losing a quarter of its accuracy by 25 cells

tagVocabulary.label: Grenadier
tagVocabulary.rule: a thrown explosive or a one-use launcher

tagVocabulary.label: Launcher
tagVocabulary.rule: fires explosive or scattering shells

tagVocabulary.label: Anti-mech
tagVocabulary.rule: an EMP weapon that harms no flesh

tagVocabulary.label: Melee
tagVocabulary.rule: a melee weapon (light under 1.5 kg, heavy from 1.5 kg)

tagVocabulary.label: Suppression
tagVocabulary.rule: bursts of 5 shots or more that strike half again as many in a bunched group

tagVocabulary.label: Brawler's pick
tagVocabulary.rule: a melee weapon rated 6.5 or more

tagVocabulary.label: Hunting
tagVocabulary.rule: a gun or bow reaching 25 cells, rated 5 or more at 12 and 25 cells, with no blast or fire to spoil the kill

tagVocabulary.label: Capture alive
tagVocabulary.rule: non-lethal, or a melee weapon whose blows are mostly blunt

tagVocabulary.label: Breacher
tagVocabulary.rule: a demolishing blow, a destructive weapon, or an explosive shot of 30 damage or more

tagVocabulary.label: Sidearm
tagVocabulary.rule: within Simple Sidearms' default limits: melee up to 1.9 kg, ranged up to 2.7 kg, not one-use

tagVocabulary.label: Offhand
tagVocabulary.rule: Dual Wield's default: not a bow or a blowgun, at most 3 kg (melee 1.5 kg), not one-use

tagVocabulary.label: Long reach
tagVocabulary.rule: reaches 34.9 cells or more, past a raider's 30.9-cell rifle

tagVocabulary.label: Dead accurate
tagVocabulary.rule: 85% accurate or better at 25 cells

tagVocabulary.label: Shreds armour
tagVocabulary.rule: keeps 55% or more of its damage against marine armour, and rates 5 or more against it

tagVocabulary.label: Mech killer
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 7 or more against mechanoids and 1.5 above its rating against flak, or stuns them with EMP

tagVocabulary.label: Crowd breaker
tagVocabulary.rule: strikes 60% more in a bunched group (a blast, a beam, a sprayed burst)

tagVocabulary.label: Stopping power
tagVocabulary.rule: stopping power 1.5 or more: staggers a charging man

tagVocabulary.label: Rapid fire
tagVocabulary.rule: 1.5 shots a second or more over its whole cycle

tagVocabulary.label: Hard hitter
tagVocabulary.rule: 25 damage or more a hit (a gun's shot, a melee weapon's best blow)

tagVocabulary.label: Quick to aim
tagVocabulary.rule: aims in 0.6 seconds or less

tagVocabulary.label: Quick strikes
tagVocabulary.rule: a melee blow every 1.6 seconds or less

tagVocabulary.label: Good defence
tagVocabulary.rule: deflects shots or adds to its wielder's dodge

tagVocabulary.label: Poor up close
tagVocabulary.rule: can't fire within 3 cells, or 55% accurate or worse there while 75% at 25 cells

tagVocabulary.label: Short range
tagVocabulary.rule: reaches under 20 cells

tagVocabulary.label: Slow to aim
tagVocabulary.rule: 2.5 seconds or more to aim

tagVocabulary.label: Long reload
tagVocabulary.rule: 3 seconds or more of cooldown after each burst

tagVocabulary.label: Wild spray
tagVocabulary.rule: 40% accurate or worse at 12 cells (not an explosive)

tagVocabulary.label: Bounces off armour
tagVocabulary.rule: keeps 40% or less of its damage against marine armour, or rates 1.8 below its own overall against it

tagVocabulary.label: Weak damage
tagVocabulary.rule: 8 damage or less a shot, or a melee weapon's best blow 10 or less

tagVocabulary.label: Heavy to carry
tagVocabulary.rule: slows its carrier, or weighs 8 kg or more

tagVocabulary.label: Mechs shrug off
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 2.5 or less against mechanoids though it harms flesh

tagVocabulary.label: Fire risk
tagVocabulary.rule: sets fires where it lands: a fire blast, fuel, a burning hit

tagVocabulary.label: Hits friends
tagVocabulary.rule: a blast of 1.5 cells or more, or a scatter of 1.5 cells or more

tagVocabulary.label: Ruins the hunt
tagVocabulary.rule: explodes or burns: spoils meat and pelts

tagVocabulary.label: One use
tagVocabulary.rule: spent after one volley

tagVocabulary.label: Can hurt you
tagVocabulary.rule: a mod's own code can blast its shooter (an overheating laser)

tagVocabulary.label: Wears out
tagVocabulary.rule: loses hit points with every shot, deteriorates, or may fall apart

tagVocabulary.label: EMP
tagVocabulary.rule: carries EMP: stuns mechanoids, breaks shield belts

tagVocabulary.label: Sets on fire
tagVocabulary.rule: sets people alight

tagVocabulary.label: Stuns
tagVocabulary.rule: stuns what it hits

tagVocabulary.label: Toxic
tagVocabulary.rule: toxic buildup or a tox gas cloud

tagVocabulary.label: Bleeds
tagVocabulary.rule: a melee weapon whose blows are mostly cuts and stabs: wounds bleed

tagVocabulary.label: Breaks bones
tagVocabulary.rule: a melee weapon whose blows are mostly blunt: cracked bones, a head blow can stun

tagVocabulary.label: Beam
tagVocabulary.rule: a beam, spray or line that strikes everyone along it

tagVocabulary.label: Grants: (ability)
tagVocabulary.rule: grants an ability, named

tagVocabulary.label: Persona bond
tagVocabulary.rule: a persona weapon: bonds to its first wielder, with persona traits

tagVocabulary.label: Unique traits
tagVocabulary.rule: a unique weapon: traits rolled when made

tagVocabulary.label: Non-lethal
tagVocabulary.rule: made to bring people down alive

tagVocabulary.label: Psychic
tagVocabulary.rule: raises its wielder's psychic sensitivity

tagVocabulary.label: Shield-breaker
tagVocabulary.rule: breaks shield belts (EMP) or passes through them

tagVocabulary.label: Needs a marksman
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 3 points or more higher at Shooting 16 than at Shooting 4

tagVocabulary.label: Needs a fighter
tagVocabulary.rule: rates 3 points or more higher at Melee 16 than at Melee 4

tagVocabulary.label: Two-handed
tagVocabulary.rule: Dual Wield's default: a bow, a shotgun, or over 3 kg

tagVocabulary.label: Biocodable
tagVocabulary.rule: can be biocoded to one colonist

tagVocabulary.label: Restricted
tagVocabulary.rule: only some can wield it (an exoframe or the Tough trait, a mage, a channeller)

tagVocabulary.label: Advanced research
tagVocabulary.rule: made only after spacer or ultra research

tagVocabulary.label: Hard to find
tagVocabulary.rule: no recipe in the player's game makes it and no faction's people carry it
